notes: Looked for duplicates across every unmatched entry, findings and risks alike; the groups above are each one point stated differently. Not grouped: E009 (no test pins the union) vs the E006 docs group (what the union contradicts); E021 (frequency of the collapse) vs E007/E030 (its mechanism); E015 vs E032, which overlap but E032 also names namesThePartner, where a real gap (E023) exists. E024 and E029 were judged NOT to match S3-r: both ask only the frequency of the residue the PR itself documents in four places (an alias filed under two substances, which by the module's account names both); neither names an alias credited where it names no drug, which is what makes S3 blocking. That is the one borderline call. E001/E020 are not S3: the answer used 'rifampin' to name rifampicin, the substance of the attached rows; their defect is which rows the ORDER rung attaches.
